critical_code_review_comments: Buy Plan uses default ASP values when no historical sales data exists for categories
Seasonal index applied for monthly phasing (Dec highest at 1.5x, Feb lowest at 0.8x)
Channel splits calculated from historical revenue or defaults (STORE_A: 35%, AMAZON: 30%)
Safety stock calculated dynamically based on lead time and daily demand
Excel export uses openpyxl with 5 sheets: Executive Summary, Category Summary, Monthly Plan, Buy Plan (Editable), Instructions
Plan history saved to buy_plan_history collection with tenant isolation
Rate limiting: 30 requests per minute per IP on generate endpoint
